guia.what: An icon is an inline `<svg class="ts icon">` from the Lucide set. It inherits the text color (`currentColor`), and you copy and paste it like any other HTML.
whenUse: Reinforcing the meaning of an action or a status that already has text.
An icon-only control where space is tight and the metaphor is well known.
You want the icon to follow the color and size of its context.
whenAvoid: The icon would have to carry the meaning alone. Add text.
It’s a content image, not a symbol → an image with `aspect-ratio`.
dos: For an icon without text, give the control that contains it an accessible name (`aria-label`).
Use the same icon for the same concept across the whole product.
donts: Don’t decorate for decoration’s sake. Every icon competes for attention.

nucleo: Inserts the icon’s SVG. It has no behavior.
